changes: Added 10 unarmored torso pieces that were missing, including Shadow Gi, Dragon Gi, Caster's Cape and Batwing Cloak.
Skills granted by equipment now show their cost and full text, including Cruel Commander's Contract of Blood and both of Tricky Yoyo's skills.
Caster's Cape, Farmer's Shirt and Healer's Shroud now raise your main class's stat bonuses by half when it is in their family.
Contract of Blood, Lion's Roar, Luckiness Dance and Needle's Spin Up now apply their stats while switched on.
Fixed Holy Word's Crusader Charge and Divine Bunker switches, which added STR and FP read from their cost and range text.
Materials with an "All:" effect now apply it on every slot their class supports, so Webbing on cloth gloves gives its Acid ATK.
Fixed glove enchantments such as Fireheart, whose elemental ATK never applied.
Fixed Rainbowbark and other materials that list several elements under one bonus.
Updated the Magical Gauntlet shields: 5 rounds, 5 FP, Magical Aegis +8 RES, and each one now grants its parry.
Magic Shield, Metallic Aegis and Magical Aegis are now switched on under Item effects, one at a time, instead of always applying.
Buffs that last a number of rounds, such as Heart of the Lion and Est Lestrada's penalty, are now switched on instead of always applying.
Fixed items that gave Armor from text like "30 armor-ignoring damage", including Creeping Darkness and Tetra Dragon Fang.
Bonuses shared across a list now apply to every stat in it: Heart of the Lion, Sunken Silk Bow and Hankyu.
Tetra Dragon Fang and Tetra Gauntlet now follow the crystal you pick: Fire, Ice, Earth or Wind.
Little Cheese's +4 WIL/GUI is now switched on under the trait, and Oni Heritage adds its +2 STR or LUC to an active Sanguine Crest.
